result.verdictReason: You’re eligible, the NAICS code matches exactly, and the work is in your home state with over two weeks to respond.
result.summary: The Phoenix VA Health Care System is buying custodial services for its main campus and two community clinics. It is a firm-fixed-price contract with a base year and four option years, set aside for small businesses.
matches: Small business set-aside, and you are a small business
Work is in Phoenix, inside your service area
Healthcare facility experience from your hospital network contract
gaps: No VA prime contract yet; your VA subcontract is relevant past performance
Every cleaner needs 12 hours of infection-control training before start

keyFacts.label: Period of performance
keyFacts.value: Base year plus four option years

keyFacts.label: Questions due
keyFacts.value: 7 days before the response date, by email

keyFacts.label: Site visit
keyFacts.value: Optional; arrange through the contracting officer

keyFacts.label: Evaluation basis
keyFacts.value: Best value; technical and past performance outweigh price

requirements.item: Signed SF 1449 with every amendment acknowledged
Technical approach, 10 pages maximum, covering staffing and quality control
Three past performance references from the last five years
Prices for every line item, base and option years
Quality control plan that meets the inspection standards
Active SAM registration that includes NAICS 561720

redFlags: The price schedule is a spreadsheet BidVerdict can’t read yet; review it yourself
questions: Is there an incumbent contractor, and how many full-time staff work on site today?
Will the government provide supplies and on-site storage for equipment?
Does commercial hospital experience count as relevant past performance?
